messages:
anna_support: FYI customer smoke tests (golden eval) started failing after last model push. CI shows multiple tool-call schema errors. CC: @devon_ml @sam_tools
ci-bot: [CI] golden-suite run #512 failed  9/140 tests. https://ci.internal/runs/512
anna_support: Error excerpt from our logs:
```
2026-03-17T07:11:03Z ERROR ToolCallValidation: tool "order_lookup" argument schema mismatch
  schema required: ["customer_id", "include_history"]
  found args: {"customer": "cust_42", "history": true}
```
logan_eng: is the model returning wrong arg names, or are we mapping incorrectly in the harness? can someone dump raw model output?
devon_ml: grabbing raw now. repro curl used for CI: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2026-04","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"lookup recent orders for cust_42"}],"functions":[{"name":"order_lookup","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"include_history":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["customer_id"]}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```
devon_ml: raw model reply:
```
{"id":"resp_890","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"order_lookup","arguments":"{\"customer\": \"cust_42\", \"history\": true}"}}}],"model":"redwood-chat-2026-04"}
```
sam_tools: so model is renaming fields (customer -> customer_id, history -> include_history) unexpectedly. CI schema validator rejects it. Good catch.
mike_oncall: unrelated but noting we saw a spike of 401s hitting tool-runner at 07:05 UTC earlier. posting logs.
mike_oncall:
```
2026-03-17T07:05:21Z WARN exec-proxy: 401 unauthorized when forwarding to tool-runner (service-account key expired), retrying 3/3
```
anna_support: ACME (acct acme-inc) opened ticket #AC-1134 referencing our golden CI failures. They are blocked from release smoke tests.
elaine_pm: need ETA for customer. any short-term workaround?
logan_eng: do not mask the regression in main CI. Proposal: create a parallel CI job for the golden suite with a normalization shim that accepts common aliases for a short window while we fix prompts/models. That way customers can unblock without hiding regressions. Thoughts?
sam_tools: I can add a normalization map in the goldens runner. It will be explicit and logged. Will add switch off by default and enable only for the customer job. Drafting PR: https://git.internal/pulls/1979
devon_ml: I reproduced locally. redwood-chat-2026-03 (previous) returns correct args (customer_id). redwood-chat-2026-04 returns the alias fields. So model revision introduced behavioral drift.
logan_eng: action list:
- devon_ml: produce minimal diff and attach raw outputs (ETA 45m)
- sam_tools: open PR for goldens normalization (ETA 1.5h)
- mike_oncall: confirm 401s are isolated and rotate service account if needed (ETA 30m)
- anna_support: notify customer of mitigation path and offer to re-run their tests using pinned model (ETA now)
ella_bot: reminder: add incident if this affects >1 customer in prod
anna_support: customer accepted rerun on pinned model. I'll coordinate.
devon_ml: attaching gist with side-by-side outputs: https://gist.internal/rdw/outputs-512
sam_tools: PR created and marked urgent. It logs normalization decisions and emits a CI warning when normalization occurs. We should revert after model stabilizes.
logan_eng: long-term: add a model-behavior contract test to the goldens that asserts canonical field names and snaps on deviations. Also add drift alerts to Optimize so customers are warned when field name entropy increases.
anna_support: copying support note to ticket #AC-1134 and offering temporary pinned run. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
